<section class="es-sec at-oversight" data-screen-label="Human Oversight">
  <div class="inner">
    <span class="eyebrow">Editorial Oversight</span>
    <h2>AI generates. Humans approve. <span class="ital">Always.</span></h2>
    <p>Every piece of automated content passes through a Kleza editorial team before it goes live. We do not publish raw AI output. Our editors verify factual accuracy, brand voice consistency, HIPAA compliance for healthcare clients, and SEO quality before scheduling.</p>
  </div>
